items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Billy Eckstine would go cram me down my throat if he knew I couldn't remember Goon's name because we were good friends.

ctx.x: Would that be the Golden Lily?
No, the Golden Lily was on Michigan. See -- hey look, you remember Goon's name? You remember Gardner Goon that played, that saxiphone player?
